summary: A review-only, hash-bound MatRIS energy-force replay fine-tuning request was prepared. It binds the six current TS labels, fifteen compatible prior TS replay labels, nine adsorption replay-training labels, four adsorption-retention validation labels, and seven immutable held-out TS exclusions. Exact-structure and rounded translation-invariant geometry overlap are both zero. No GPU fine-tuning or path rerun was submitted.

payload.objective: Implement and locally validate a production MatRIS energy-and-force training executor against the reviewed replay request, then obtain separate user authorization before any MZ73 fine-tuning execution.
current_evidence: The canonical MatRIS fine-tune preflight passes with no blockers and binds active state, trigger assessment, current labels, policy, base checkpoint, and held-out exclusions.
The optimizer pool contains 6 current TS labels, 15 prior TS replay labels, and 9 adsorption replay labels; 4 additional adsorption structures are validation-only.
All 21 TS samples contain 50 atoms with identical atom order, cell, and fixed layer under the SIGMA=0.20 eV compatibility branch.
All 30 optimizer/replay structures were checked against 7 frozen held-out structures; exact hash overlap and rounded translation-invariant geometry overlap are both zero.
The existing local MatRIS benchmark trainer is force-only, so it cannot satisfy the triggered energy-and-force-aware production request without a separately reviewed executor change.
No MZ73 job, new checkpoint, complete-path rerun, VASP job, micro-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier action was executed.
payload.one_executable_step: Implement and locally test the energy-and-force-aware MatRIS production trainer using the prepared manifest; do not upload or submit it without separate user authorization.
payload.submission_boundary: The review request is preparation evidence only. MZ73 fine-tuning, checkpoint promotion, complete ML-path rerun, AQCat25 returned-path audit, VASP micro-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, and barrier actions remain unauthorized.
done_when: The production trainer consumes the hash-bound replay manifest, enforces held-out exclusions before optimizer construction, and trains movable-atom forces plus within-system relative energies.
A bounded local or non-production smoke test validates loss construction, checkpoint output hashing, force-tail checks, and adsorption-retention checks.
The user separately authorizes or declines the reviewed MZ73 fine-tuning execution.
